mid_cycle_expectation.platform_question: Did recommendations-api increase its Redis pool capacity beyond the redis-features client limit?

ground_truth.root_cause: recommendations-api increased REDIS_POOL_MAX_SIZE from 40 to 140 across four replicas, saturating redis-features maxclients=450 when combined with existing consumers.
ground_truth.recommendation: Request approval to restore REDIS_POOL_MAX_SIZE to 40 and verify redis-features rejected connections and recommendation errors recover.

known_false_leads_applied: Do not begin with an application-code regression when dependency rejection precedes service errors and service resources are healthy.
